summary_from_search: Q1 2026 earnings reported April 22: $5.203B net sales (+11.6% reported, +9.4% organic), adj EPS $0.80, but FY guidance lowered. Next earnings expected Q2 2026 (likely late July). Key forward catalysts: EP segment recovery, WATCHMAN FLX Pro launch, CHAMPION clinical data. Stock down ~12% over 30 days on EP/WATCHMAN slowdown fears. Analysts view EP share loss as temporary.
